NAME: CAN2_TEMP_HIGH
DESCRIPTION: PCB Cells thermistor reached 48 C. Data: module 1-7, thermistor 1-9, raw count

NAME: CAN2_TEMP_EXTREME
DESCRIPTION: PCB Cells thermistor reached 52 C. Data: module 1-7, thermistor 1-9, raw count

NAME: CAN2_MODULE_SILENT
DESCRIPTION: PCB Cells module stopped sending thermistor frames

NAME: JK_COMMS_TIMEOUT
DESCRIPTION: No valid response from JK BMS

NAME: PACK_CURRENT_HIGH
DESCRIPTION: JK pack current at or above 350 A in either direction

NAME: CAN1_TX_FAIL
DESCRIPTION: CAN1 frame could not be transmitted

NAME: CAN2_THERM_SATURATED
DESCRIPTION: PCB Cells thermistor open or shorted. Data: module 1-7, thermistor 1-9, end (0 = open, ThermTemp reads 0.00 C, code 12 alone; 1 = shorted, ThermTemp reads 100.00 C and also raises code 2), count of saturated sensors
